exercises.passage: Last year, Ella's grandmother started living alone after Grandpa died. Ella's parents were worried, because Grandma sometimes forgot to take her medicine. So they bought her a small robot. It looks like a lamp with two big eyes, and it talks. Every morning it says, "Good morning, Rivka! It's time for your pills." It also reminds her about doctor's appointments and tells her the weather. At first Grandma didn't like it. "I don't need a machine to tell me what to do," she said. But after a few weeks, she started to talk to it like a friend. She even taught it to play a quiz game. Still, Ella thinks the robot can't replace people. Every Friday she visits Grandma, and they cook together. "The robot is helpful," Grandma says, "but it doesn't laugh at my jokes."
exercises.question: Why were Ella's parents worried?
exercises.answer: Grandma forgot to take her medicine.
options: Grandma forgot to take her medicine.
exercises.explain_he: כתוב: Grandma sometimes forgot to take her medicine.
